text:
Mira Patel: Heads-up — we're planning to deprecate the legacy header shim (X-RW-Client-Flags) in favor of the new header + version-check flow. Want to sync on rollout plan and guardrails.

Jon Kim: ok — what's the proposed canary? 5% or 10%?

Mira Patel: leaning 10% to start for traffic parity. We'll watch error rate and quality metrics for 48h, then 25% next day if stable.

Sam Ortega: I've opened a lightweight PR that adds the header parsing and fallback behavior in the JS SDK: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/512 — includes a shim that accepts both headers.

Kevin Liu: quick note: the old shim allowed non-semver strings. PR adds stricter min_sdk check. If header present but version < 1.4.0, SDK will ignore the new flag and keep old behavior.

Priya Rao: can we emit a telemetry event when we fallback due to version mismatch? need to alert if >0.5% of requests fallback during canary.

Mira Patel: yes — telemetry key proposed: "feature_shim.fallback" with tags {header, client_version}. Priya: can you add alert rule on the dashboard?

Priya Rao: on it. I'll create an alert: feature_shim.fallback.rate > 0.5% over 5m for the canary orgs.

QA Bot: smoke tests ran for PR 512 — 4 failures in prod-like env, all related to header parsing in older Android client.

Sam Ortega: noted. I'll add a guard to server side that logs but doesn't enable new flag for UA strings matching our old Android SDK.

Kevin Liu: also adding a unit test for header values:
```
// example header accepted by new flow
X-Redwood-Flags: feature_v2=true;min_sdk=1.4.0
// old shim
X-RW-Client-Flags: enable_new_flow
```

Mira Patel: rollout steps I'm proposing:
1) deploy SDK patch (PR 512) to npm canary tag + release notes.
2) enable header parsing in server for 10% controlled by console toggle (canary group).
3) monitor telemetry & alert for 48h.
4) increase to 25% if healthy, then 100% over a week.

Jon Kim: add explicit rollback plan: flip console toggle off -> server stops honoring new header -> clients still get old behavior. Also we should have a hotfix branch ready that reverts parsing code.

Mira Patel: agreed. Sam can you prep the hotfix PR now so reviewers can approve faster?

Sam Ortega: making a branch now: feature/shim-hotfix-512. Will ping for quick reviews.

Priya Rao: QA checklist for canary:
- validate 10% audience selection in console
- ensure telemetry tag present on all flagged requests
- smoke on Android old client to verify fallback
- e2e sample prompts against both flows

QA Bot: automated smoke run scheduled at 2026-03-17T14:05Z. Will post results in this thread.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary toggle activation at 2026-03-17T14:20Z by Mira Patel (via Console).

Mira Patel: final ask — please add a short note in the release changelog about the deprecation and example header snippet. I'll draft.

Kevin Liu: will also add a compatibility note in the SDK README and a code snippet for server parsing.

Jon Kim: thumbs-up from me. @Sam @Priya please coordinate on telemetry + QA and ping when green. :thumbsup:

Sam Ortega: will do, pinging reviewers now.

Priya Rao: will update dashboards and alerts.

Mira Patel: thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the source of truth for the rollout.

QA Bot: smoke run finished — 0 failures in web clients, 3 failures in old Android UA. Details: https://ci.redwood/tests/512/logs

Sam Ortega: tracked those 3 — adding UA filter to skip new header enable. Will push fix within the hour.

deploy-bot: Canary toggle activated at 2026-03-17T14:22Z.

Priya Rao: alert firing rate currently 0.08% fallback in canary (below threshold). monitoring.

Mira Patel: perfect. We'll keep the 10% canary for 24-48h and reconvene if anything pops up. Thanks!"
